title: Luciq Autopilot | Automated Bug Fixing for Mobile Apps
markdown:
# Automated bug fixing for mobile, with guardrails built in.

An issue arises at midnight; you wake up to a ready-to-review PR. Integrate any agent, Claude, Cursor, or your own, to prepare the fix, run it across every signal from crashes to feature requests, and let guardrails halt a bad release before it ever reaches your users.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/6a68f661bbbb7c6dba279947_autopilot_hero_illustration.webp)

![Pull request icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/6a612f097e895c362bfe0c3b_autopilot_autopilot_icon_PR.webp)

A PR waiting at midnight

An alert trips at 2am, your agent prepares the fix, and a ready-to-review pull request is waiting when you wake up, no one watching.

![Bring-your-own-agent icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/6a612f17a0bac756605f5d5f_autopilot_autopilot_icon_bringanyagent.webp)

Bring any agent

Integrate Claude, Cursor, or your own framework to prepare the fix, or run Luciq's own Resolve Agent. Your keys, your choice.

![Guardrails icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/6a612f206d49785deede7d63_autopilot_autopilot_icon_guardrails.webp)

Guardrails that protect users

Halt a risky release and stop feature flags automatically, before damage spreads. Every action auditable, scoped, and reversible.

## A ready-to-review PR, even at midnight

Put an alert on a release, and when it trips at 2am it doesn't ping a channel for someone to read, it hands the issue straight to your agent. The agent reads the full Luciq context, prepares the fix, and opens the pull request, on your side and on your keys. You wake up to a fix ready for review, with no one watching.

![Code fix interface showing steps: Fix, Validate, Merge, Build, Deploy with code changes for XML DOM parsing.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/6a68f6821722dc6ab65a6906_autopilot_autopilot_illustration_automaticfixes.webp)

## Integrate any agent to prepare the fix

You didn't adopt our agent, we gave yours everything it needs. Connect Claude, Cursor, or your own framework over MCP and it works the issue on your keys. Prefer ours? Hit Generate Fix and the Resolve Agent spins up a sandboxed copy of the codebase, reasons through the root cause in real time, and opens the PR.

![Illustration of bringing your own AI agent](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/6a612f3dd484e02ae5488deb_autopilot_autopilot_illustration_bringyourownagent.webp)

## Every signal on autopilot, not just crashes

Crashes are only the start. ANRs, performance regressions, user-reported bugs, and even opportunities and feature requests can each trigger a routine, so the same hands-off workflow runs across everything Luciq captures, from a stack trace to a feature your users keep asking for.

![Illustration of acting on every signal automatically](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/6a612f4a056b0dc182d77c1b_autopilot_autopilot_illustration_everysignal.webp)

## Halt the release before it spreads

When a release starts degrading real sessions, Autopilot protects your users automatically, halting the rollout or flipping off a feature flag before the damage reaches more people. The same engine that fires a fix now guards the release, so a bad build never makes it out.

![Illustration of protecting users with automated fixes](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/6a612f562b4073efe0a49ba0_autopilot_autopilot_illustration_protectyourusers.webp)

## Ship your first automated fix, fast.

You don't script every routine from scratch. Ready-made resolution templates get Autopilot working on your codebase in minutes, not weeks of workflow-building.

1

Pick a resolution template

Start from ready-made templates for common triggers, crash spikes, ANRs, and regressions, instead of building rules from zero.

2

Bring your agent, or run ours

Connect Claude, Cursor, or your own framework, or hit Generate Fix and let the Resolve Agent take the first pass.

3

The first PR is ready to review

Guardrails are on by default. Your first automated fix, and your first protected release, ship the same day.

## Automation you can trust to ship.

Every action Autopilot takes is logged, scoped by role and team, and reversible. Human-in-the-loop where it matters, hands-off where it's safe, the way enterprise teams adopt agent automation.
